# transformers.quantizers

## transformers.quantizers

- `AutoHfQuantizer()` — The Auto-HF quantizer class that takes care of automatically instantiating to the correct `HfQuantizer` given the `QuantizationConfig`.
- `AutoQuantizationConfig()` — The Auto-HF quantization config class that takes care of automatically dispatching to the correct quantization config given a quantization config stored in a dictionary.
- `HfQuantizer(quantization_config: transformers.utils.quantization_config.QuantizationConfigMixin, **kwargs)` — Abstract class of the HuggingFace quantizer. Supports for now quantizing HF transformers models for inference and/or quantization. This class is used only for transformers.PreTrainedModel.from_pretrained and cannot be easily used outside the scope of that method yet.
- `get_module_from_name(module, tensor_name: str) -> tuple[typing.Any, str]` — function
- `register_quantization_config(method: str)` — Register a custom quantization configuration.
- `register_quantizer(name: str)` — Register a custom quantizer.
